Dear Miss Yonge,

How does page(?) suit your idea of the [History book](/book/71)?

What you sent me was about 240 pages like the specimens.

So the whole would be too much for one volume.

Can we make two - or three?

Are there any natural divisions?

Very faithfully yours

[A.

Macmillan](/person/939)

Among the books that were transferred to us from [Parker](/organisation/152) are some copies of [Dynevor Terrace](/book/27) in the two volume form we don’t sell [illegible]  of course.

Had I not better sell them to [Routledge](/organisation/258) or [Smiths](/organisation/161) at a very cheap price?

&nbsp;
